question: What is Hearth's return window?
expected_answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to your original payment method. Items must be unused and in original condition. Personalized/made-to-order pieces and opened bath & body products can't be returned. If something arrived damaged or wrong, contact support within 14 days.
notes: Platform returns policy: 30 days, exclusions, 14-day damage window.

question: How long does shipping take and when is it free?
expected_answer: Most makers ship within 2 business days. Standard delivery in the continental US takes 3–7 business days; international orders typically 7–21 business days depending on customs. Shipping is free on orders over $75; below that a flat $6 applies.
notes: Platform shipping policy.

question: What payment methods do you accept, and when is my card charged?
expected_answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards. Your card is charged when the order is placed. For made-to-order items, you're charged at purchase and the maker begins work right away. Prices are in US dollars and include applicable taxes at checkout. We never store your full card number on our servers.
notes: Platform payments policy.

question: Can I return a custom-sized Herrera belt if I change my mind?
expected_answer: No — belts cut to a custom size are made to order and can't be returned unless they arrive faulty, so double-check your measurement before ordering. Stock items (card wallets, in-stock belt sizes) do follow Hearth's standard 30-day return policy. If a custom belt arrives with a defect, Herrera will remake or refund it — reach out within 14 days with a photo.
notes: Store-level override vs platform 30-day: combines two policy docs.

question: How do I care for my Sólveig stoneware mug — can it go in the dishwasher and microwave?
expected_answer: Yes — Sólveig stoneware is dishwasher- and microwave-safe, though the occasional hand wash keeps the glaze looking best. Avoid sudden temperature changes (don't go freezer-to-hot-oven). Small glaze variations and the odd tiny iron speck are normal marks of a handmade piece, not defects.
notes: Store care policy for Solveig ceramics.

question: How should I trim and first-burn my Fenn candle, and can I return it if I don't like the scent after lighting it?
expected_answer: Trim the wick to about 5mm before each light, and let the first burn reach the edge of the glass (about 2 hours) so it won't tunnel. Note that Fenn's bath & body and candle products can't be returned once opened, for hygiene reasons — but if something's wrong with your order, contact them within 14 days.
notes: Care + no-return-once-opened both in the single Fenn care policy doc.

question: Who actually makes the products on Hearth, and how much of each sale goes to the maker?
expected_answer: Hearth is a marketplace for independent makers. Every item is made or finished by hand by the seller listed on the product page, and the maker keeps the large majority of each sale. New sellers are vetted for quality and honesty, and makers are asked to describe goods plainly. If a listing is ever inaccurate, tell us and we'll fix it.
notes: Platform 'About Hearth' policy.

question: I bought an opened jar of the Salve Hand Balm and want to return it because I didn't like the scent — can I?
expected_answer: Unfortunately no — opened bath & body products can't be returned, for hygiene reasons; that's both Hearth's platform policy and Fenn Apothecary's care policy. The Salve Hand Balm is a bath & body item. If the balm arrived damaged or wasn't what you ordered, contact support within 14 days and we'll make it right.
notes: Combines platform returns exclusion + Fenn care + product is Bath & Body. Honest no-return.
